info.name: Handi API v1
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Handi (What to Cook) API with recorded examples.

1. Set `base_url` (default http://localhost:8000/api — use your LAN IP from a phone).
2. Run **Auth → Log in** (demo user) or **Sign up**; the token is saved to `{{token}}` automatically.
3. Ids returned by Today, My dishes, Custom dishes, Meals and Notifications are saved as variables for the follow-up requests.

Full guide: docs/api.md · interactive docs: /docs/api

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign up with the whole onboarding kitchen in one call, log in, log out. Both return a Sanctum token.

request.description:
Creates the account together with everything chosen during onboarding:
family & budget, preferences, location, at least 10 dishes and any custom dishes.

response.name: 201 example
422 example

exec: try { const v = json.data.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("token", v); } catch (e) {}

request.description:
Five wrong passwords lock this email (from this IP) for 60 seconds.
Wrong password → 401 with `attempts_left`; locked → 429 with `retry_after`.

response.name: 401 example
200 example

exec: try { const v = json.data.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("token", v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Revokes this phone's token and stops reminders on it.

item.name: Auth · password reset
item.description: Forgot password → 6-digit code by email (15 min, 5 tries, resend after 45 s) → reset token → new password. Never reveals whether an email exists.

request.description: Always 202. Includes the masked email, how long the code is valid and when it can be resent.

response.name: 202 example

request.description: 429 with `retry_after` if asked again within 45 seconds.

response.name: 429 example

request.description:
Returns a `reset_token` for “Set new password”. Wrong code → 422 with `attempts_left`;
after 5 wrong codes → 429 (request a new code).

response.name: 422 example
200 example

exec: try { const v = json.data.reset_token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("reset_token", v); } catch (e) {}

the planned dish, today's log from the picks, stats and when the next picks arrive.
